Laptop feels very slow during everyday tasks
System hangs or freezes for several seconds, especially during Teams calls
High CPU usage shown in Task Manager (often >80%)
Fan runs constantly and laptop gets warm
Boot time exceeds two minutes
Too many programs configured to launch at startup
Background services or apps consuming excessive CPU/RAM
Accumulation of temporary files and cache reducing disk performance
Pending Windows updates that require a restart after extended uptime
Insufficient memory (less than 8GB) for the current workload
Presence of unwanted software or malware
Open Task Manager by pressing Ctrl+Shift+Esc, then select the Startup tab
Sort the list by Startup impact. Disable any item marked "High" that you do not recognize or that is not essential for your work (right-click -> Disable)
Open Settings -> Apps -> Startup and toggle off additional non-essential apps that appear here
If you prefer using the classic tool, press Win+R, type msconfig and hit Enter. In the Services
